description.title: Cowboy App
description.text: The future of riding? It's here. From advanced-navigation and safety features, to groundbreaking theft protection and ride analysis. The Cowboy App is your co-pilot on and off the road.

description.title: Theft Protection
description.text: Your bike locks itself automatically, and alerts you the moment it moves. Find My Bike pinpoints its exact location using GPS hidden deep within the frame. Designed to outsmart thieves, it's peace of mind that feels like magic.

description.title: Removable battery
description.text: With a lightweight, removable battery, recharge wherever it suits you. At home, at work, or on the go - no need to bring your bike inside. And with smart alerts and Eco Mode you'll go further with every charge. 2hrs 40mins charging time
